evidence.title: Claude + Linkedin. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Claude + Linkedin.
summary: Guide to training Claude on your LinkedIn posts and turning your own writing style into a reusable skill.
description: A Substack post in the How to AI newsletter, by Ruben Hassid: extract around 1,000 of your public LinkedIn posts with a $2 tool, upload them to Claude as a spreadsheet, build a custom skill from your best posts, and invoke that skill whenever you write.
